mines.mine_notes: 100%-owned flagship development project in the Paterson Province, ~35 km from Greatland's Telfer gold-copper-silver mine and ~54 km along strike from Havieron. Twelve deposits at Minyari Dome distributed along a 3.5 km strike corridor plus satellite deposits (WACA, WACA West, Sundown, RPS). GEO-01 area continues to offer strong resource growth potential (H1 CY2026 follow-up). August 2026: drilling expanded Tim's Dome gold-copper-lead-silver mineralisation across >1 km strike; diamond drilling testing 1.2 km-long AEM conductor. PFS (standalone development opportunity) targeted Q3 2026; FID to follow. Metallurgical recoveries (Antipa 2017-2018 testwork): Au 88%, Cu 85%, Ag 85%, Co 68%; AuEq = Au + Ag*0.012 + Cu%*1.32 + Co%*5.88.
